Group diagonal colour assignments by first repeat p<q<=n+1,ell. Let u=Apell,v=Aqell,s=Bellp,t=Bellq,D=uvst,R=sum_a!=ell Apa Baq,S=sum_a!=ell Aqa Bap; Lpq omits the two cross factors; Jpqell sums products A_i,alpha(i) B_alpha(i),i over injective alpha:[q-1]->[n] with alpha(p)=ell, omitting i=p; T=J prod_i>q Eii. U=vs(tZu+u²Zt),V=ut(sZv+v²Zs),K=(1+vs+S)U+RV give formal P=Q(X,b)+residual, Q=sum LTK, residual=sum LTDRS. Q is linear in the full placeholder tuple. There are n*binomial(n+1,2) groups. Given J circuits of total size H and depth e, Q and residual have polynomial size in H+m+n and depth<=e+10. No cost bound for J or residual correction is supplied. At n1 the residual vanishes and the construction is a cheap full correction. At n>=2 DRS is locally nonzero; this does not say its complete coupled sum is nonzero on Boolean points.
